claim_limit: Equilibrium cp is numerically qualified against re-solves; the measured comparison is empirical on one adopted model. Neutral ideal-gas cp inputs (water NIST Shomate extrapolated below 500 K; MEA Zhang-Que-Chen 2011 Table 3, Aspen, uncertainty unreported) enter cp directly. Hilliard loading 0.358 vs model 0.35. The pure-water residual cp deficit (12-15 % below IAPWS-95) is the same order as the gap; the model's falling equilibrium cp against rising measurements comes from the reaction-shift term, which depends on K(T) and the reference calorics and is unresolved.
